svg.title: RU-EN-LID Stage 3: gate and verification
svg.desc: A confidence gate keeps words Stage 2 is sure about. Deferred words go to one resolver chosen by their Stage-1 tag: lexicon priors, variant consistency, or a context decoder that charges a penalty for each Urdu-English switch.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Confident words are kept. Each deferred word goes to the one resolver that has evidence for it.
